## How it was tested

- [ ] `cargo test` / `cargo clippy` pass locally
- [ ] Tested in `--mock` mode
- [ ] Tested with a real phone (describe below)
- [ ] `omarchy plugin validate plugin` (if the plugin changed)
- [ ] Verified in the running shell, with panel-only screenshots from `--mock` attached (visual changes)
- [ ] Checked with a light and a dark Omarchy theme (visual changes)

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a succinct imperative sentence (it becomes the squash commit on `main`)
- [ ] Follows [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) (Omarchy style, theme tokens only)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased* (for user-visible changes)
- [ ] No personal data committed (MAC addresses, phone numbers, vCards, recordings)
